evidence.note: The genealogy opens with the Syriac name יֵשֻוע followed by the title משִיחָא, “Messiah.”
The angel tells Joseph to call the child Jesus because he will save his people from their sins.

name: יֵשֻוע
summary: Matthew introduces Jesus as the Messiah, son of David and son of Abraham. The instruction to name him Jesus connects his name with the Hebrew root ישע, “save,” by saying that he will save his people from their sins.
